svg.title: Encoder auto-sync: re-align when the module is still
svg.desc: Animated. A dial with two needles on one steering module: the absolute encoder, the truth, and the steering motor's encoder, with a gray deadband wedge around the absolute needle. While the module steers, the motor encoder's needle slowly drifts away. The module stops with a small gap inside the deadband: it is left alone. It steers again and the gap grows past the deadband; when the module is still, the motor encoder snaps back onto the absolute encoder: re-aligned. A graph below traces the gap over time, with the still times shaded. Auto-sync fixes slow drift of the motor encoder during a match; the deadband stops it from fighting tiny disagreements.
svg.text: Encoder auto-sync: re-align when the module is still
When the module is still, the motor encoder is set back to the absolute encoder.
deadband: tiny gaps are left alone

g.text: Moving: the motor encoder slowly drifts.
Still, gap inside the deadband: left alone.
Still, gap outside the deadband: re-aligned.

svg.text: The gap between the two encoders, over time
Fixes slow drift of the motor encoder during a match.
The deadband stops it from fighting tiny disagreements.
